title: Universality of Infinite Chess
summary: We prove that chess played on the infinite chessboard $\mathbb{Z}^2$ with infinitely many pieces is as powerful as it could possibly be, by showing that every open Gale-Stewart game with draws is strategically equivalent to some infinite chess position and vice versa. As our construction is computable and open Gale-Stewart games are well understood, this allows us to resolve many open questions about the complexity of infinite chess with infinitely many pieces.
